item.title: 【Off-Topic】Barbie dvd 576p remuxes
item.description: The link to this is now dead, unfortunately. I was wondering if anyone would be willing to share all of the files from Blackbird. I plan to fix some of the audio quality issues with Eden's encoded files, which I all have. The reason I need these specific ones is because the 576P Barbie DVDs are in 25 FPS, which is what Eden's Barbie movie files are. I also plan to remaster all of them further in 4K resolution. I'm trying to get as many people to see this to increase my chances.
item.author: Regina
